mapper.select: select (select count(1) from faucet_claim_request where chain_id = #{chainId} and user_address = #{user} and day = #{day} and status in ('SUBMITTED','CONFIRMED')) as user_claim_count, (select max(created_at) from faucet_claim_request where chain_id = #{chainId} and user_address = #{user} and day = #{day} and status in ('SUBMITTED','CONFIRMED')) as user_last_claim_at, (select count(1) from faucet_claim_request where chain_id = #{chainId} and ip_hash = #{ipHash} and day = #{day} and status in ('SUBMITTED','CONFIRMED')) as ip_claim_count, (select (count(1) > 0) from faucet_blacklist where chain_id = #{chainId} and active = true and (user_address = #{user} or ip_hash = #{ipHash})) as blocked
